hero.title: Track your job applications in one place
hero.description: Stop juggling spreadsheets and emails. Manage every application, interview, and follow-up from a single dashboard.

problem.label: The problem
problem.title: The old way makes it easy to miss opportunities
problem.description: Most candidates start with a spreadsheet. It works for a few applications, then quickly becomes hard to maintain as your pipeline grows.

oldWay.title: The old way — Excel chaos
points: Hard to see your full pipeline at a glance
Follow-ups get buried in spreadsheet rows
No analytics on interview or offer conversion
Difficult to keep CVs organized per application

newWay.title: The new way — Interview Tracker
points: Kanban board shows every stage in one view
Follow-up alerts highlight applications that need action
Dashboard tracks interview and offer rates over time
Upload and manage a CV for each application

features.label: Features
features.title: Everything you need to stay on top of applications
features.description: Interview Tracker is built around the actual workflow of applying, interviewing, and following up — not generic task management.

items.title: Application tracking
items.description: Create, edit, and organize every job application with company, role, dates, notes, and job links.

items.title: Kanban board
items.description: Drag applications across Applied, Interview, Offer, and Rejected columns to reflect your real pipeline.

items.title: Dashboard analytics
items.description: See interview rate, offer rate, rejection rate, pipeline progress, and monthly application trends.

items.title: Follow-up reminders
items.description: Applications that stay in Applied too long are highlighted so you know when to follow up.

items.title: Real-time notifications
items.description: Get notified when status changes or when an application needs your attention.

items.title: Resume / CV management
items.description: Attach a PDF resume to each application and open it anytime from your board or list view.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.title: A simple workflow from apply to offer

steps.title: Add your applications
steps.description: Log company, role, apply date, job link, notes, and optionally upload your CV.

steps.title: Move them through stages
steps.description: Use the Kanban board to track progress from Applied to Interview, Offer, or Rejected.

steps.title: Review and act
steps.description: Check the dashboard for trends, respond to notifications, and follow up when needed.

cta.title: Ready to organize your job search?
cta.description: Create an account and start tracking applications with a Kanban board, analytics dashboard, notifications, and CV uploads — all in one project you can actually use.

footer.tagline: Interview Tracker — job application management project
